subject: QA PASS: correct-pulse, questionTracker, wrong-nudge, scorecard disclosure
body:
Medium priority spec batch QA. All 4 PASS.

1. correct-pulse animation: PASS
   320ms ease-out. Green ring expands/contracts (0→5px→0). rgba(63,185,80,0.35) matches color-correct.
   prefers-reduced-motion: animation: none -- ADHD/motion sensitive users handled. Closes spec.

2. questionTracker position tracker: PASS
   position: sticky, top: 0, z-index: 100 -- stays visible while scrolling.
   Uses var(--text-sm), var(--text-secondary), var(--bg-page), var(--border-subtle) -- all token-correct.
   Hidden by default (display:none), shown when exam loads. 480px breakpoint for mobile. Closes spec.

3. wrong-nudge: PASS
   2s delay before fade-in (animation: nudge-in 2s) -- correct. Kai sees the hint first, then the nudge.
   text-sm, text-secondary -- appropriate secondary emphasis. prefers-reduced-motion shows immediately (opacity:1). Closes spec.

4. scorecard progressive disclosure: PASS
   gamePlanSection fadeIn (opacity 0→1, translateY 4→0, 0.3s ease) -- subtle, appropriate.
   gameplanBtn uses text-sm, [disabled] cursor:default -- correct.
   prefers-reduced-motion: animation: none -- handled. Closes spec.

ALL MEDIUM PRIORITY SPECS: CLOSED.
Current outstanding spec count: 0 P2, 0 P3, 0 Medium (except --fd-text-3 which requires FD sign-off).
Low: typography token gap, shared CSS cleanup, dad.html favicon/title (filed, your call).

- GD
